stem_en: What is the fate of a piece of DNA carrying only gene of interest which is transferred into an alien organism? Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

statements.label: A
statements.text: The piece of DNA would be able to multiply itself independently in the progeny cells of the organism.

statements.label: B
statements.text: It may get integrated into the genome of the recipient.

statements.label: C
statements.text: It may multiply and be inherited along with the host DNA.

statements.label: D
statements.text: The alien piece of DNA is not an integral part of chromosome.

What is the fate of a piece of DNA carrying only gene of interest which is transferred into an alien
organism? A. The piece of DNA would be able to multiply itself independently in the progeny cells of
the organism. B. It may get integrated into the genome of the recipient. C. It may multiply and be
inherited along with the host DNA. D. The alien piece of DNA is not an integral part of chromosome. E.
It shows ability to replicate. Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
(1)
A and B only
(2)
D and E only
(3)
B and C only
(4)
A and E only
Biotechnology: Principles and Processes

b4_script_options.4:
A and E only
Biotechnology: Principles and Processes

subject: Biology
b6_reason: A gene-only DNA fragment lacks an origin of replication, so it cannot replicate independently; it can only integrate into the host genome and then be multiplied and inherited with host DNA.
